name: Flights left open
title: Flights left open: a flight in the next two weeks that leaves your work calendar looking free, in the morning brief, with one press to block it as out of office
aliases: out of office for a flight

events.blocked: You pressed Block it as out of office on a flight in the morning brief
events.put: You pressed Not needed on a flight in the morning brief

runs.shown: Rouh put a flight your main calendar shows you free during in the morning brief

permissions: reads the next fourteen days of every calendar the connected Google account sees, each time the morning brief opens
puts Google's own out-of-office on your main calendar for a flight only when you press Block it as out of office; Google declines new invitations then with a short note
keeps the flights you put away or blocked in your own settings
touches.remove: Turn the switch flight_open off on its row in Evolution, Mutations, and the section is gone and the route refuses; to remove it for good revert night 32's flight_open commit (rouh/flight_open.py, the brief_flight_open route and its lines in rouh/web/brief.py and rouh/project/urls.py, drawFlightOpen and its helpers in briefpage.js and its rules in briefpage.css, this manifest) and delete the user setting flight_open. Calendar.block in rouh/google_api/calendar.py is shared with Away and focus time.
